import sys, zipfile
def load(p):
    z = zipfile.ZipFile(p)
    return {i.filename: (z.read(i), i.date_time) for i in z.infolist()}
a, b = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
print("names equal:", sorted(a) == sorted(b))
byt = [n for n in a if n in b and a[n][0] != b[n][0]]
tim = [n for n in a if n in b and a[n][1] != b[n][1]]
print("bytes differ:", byt)
print("times differ:", len(tim), "of", len(a))
EOF
